name: agentboard-workspace
description: AgentBoard monorepo workspace during architecture refactor.

scripts.build: npm run build:provider-bundles && npm --prefix core run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ui && npm --prefix core run typecheck && npm run typecheck:engine && npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run typecheck:plugin-sdk && npm run typecheck:infrastructure && npm run typecheck:providers && npm run typecheck:hosts && npm run typecheck:server
scripts.typecheck:providers: node core/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p plugins/providers/claude/tsconfig.json --pretty false && node core/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p plugins/providers/codex/tsconfig.json --pretty false && node core/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p plugins/providers/copilot/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.typecheck:hosts: node core/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p plugins/hosts/claude-code/tsconfig.json --pretty false && node core/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p plugins/hosts/codex/tsconfig.json --pretty false && node core/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p plugins/hosts/copilot/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.test: npm --prefix core run test && npm run test:engine && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:plugin-sdk && npm run test:infrastructure && npm run test:providers && npm run test:hosts && npm run test:server && npm run test:host-startup
